card.name: Start of drug names after 'the'
card.fires_on: The first piece of a brand or generic drug name that begins with O or AVO (ONSWIK, OTEZLA-like names, ritavancin), often right after 'the', 'Adjust', 'discontinue' or 'Reconstitute'. Also 'THE' in all-caps dosing warnings.

modes.label: Drug name start
modes.description: The opening letters of an unusual drug name, usually starting with O, split into pieces.

modes.label: Capitalized warning phrase
modes.description: The word THE inside an all-caps instruction before RECOMMENDED.
modes.example: DO NOT EXCEED<< THE>> RECOMMENDED INFUSION RATE of

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing a name or a word like 'advise', and away from 'recommended' and 'desired'.
card.plain: It fires at the start of an unfamiliar drug name, mostly one beginning with O, right where the name is about to continue.
